messages:
Leah M: Quick question 1 converting contractor Sam K to a 0.6 FTE perm role. Manager proposes prorated comp $78,000 (from $130k FTE). That sits above the S3 prorated cap by ~$3k. What's the approval path and can we align a 2025-06-02 start date?

Jon P: Thanks Leah. Candidate verbally accepted. Role level IC2, no relocation. We'd like payroll to reflect start 2025-06-02 but willing to wait to next payroll window if needed.

Priya - People Ops: Routing quick checklist: manager justification + org head signoff; finance to confirm prorate and headcount funding; comp committee approval for >$2k prorate exceptions; legal review for contractor->employee status; benefits to confirm part-time eligibility and effective coverage date. I can create HR ticket if you drop the manager justification here.

Leah M: Manager justification: "Critical bug-fix ownership for legacy infra; deep domain knowledge; conversion reduces contractor spend and improves continuity. Hiring internally preferred for retention." Also attaching short CV in the ticket.

Jon P: Confirming manager signoff here. We prefer start 2025-06-02; fallback 2025-06-16 if payroll miss.

Finance Bot: Please include org code and chargeback center. Prorate calc looks correct. If committee requests uplift, we'll detail budget impact. CFO approval needed for any permanent uplift >$5k annually.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks 1 creating HR ticket now: HR-TICKET-1749999999. Routing to finance@, comp-committee@, legal@, benefits@. Please reply with `+approve` or `-need info`.

Legal Ops: Quick flag: contractor conversion needs signed offer + IP/NDAs updated. Also confirm last contractor invoice date to ensure no overlap.

Jon P: No overlap, last contractor invoice planned 2025-05-31. Offer will be signed before start.

Priya - People Ops: Ping comp committee: committee meets Wed. If we get manager justification + org signoff today, we'll put this on the agenda. Can someone from comp confirm whether this is S3 vs S4 banding?

Comp Chair (via DM): We'll need benchmarking doc. At 0.6 FTE prorated number >band by ~$3k triggers committee. Likely options: approve band exception, shift to S4 with justification, or approve equity/top-up instead of base.

Leah M: Candidate will accept base-only, prefers no equity. If committee requires equity instead of base uplift that's likely a dealbreaker.

Priya - People Ops: Noted. Jon pls confirm candidate's benefits expectations (medical/pto pro rata etc) so benefits team can pre-calc.

Jon P: Candidate expects pro-rated medical and PTO. Will confirm in writing by EOD.

Finance Bot: Also confirm chargeback org code ASAP for payroll setup.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks all 1 ticket HR-TICKET-1749999999 created: https://redwood.internal/hr/HR-TICKET-1749999999. I'll update once comp committee decides.
